incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert group created for service= inference-gateway (us-west-2). 18 alerts auto-grouped. Incident: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-7a1c23 

pagerduty: PAGE FIRED -> On-call: caroline (primary). Escalation in 5m if not acked.

caroline: Acked on PD. jumping in. quick summary from alert: 5xx spike from inference-gateway -> backend timeout/503s, mostly affecting /v1/generate on hosted API.

alex: I see the same in router metrics — error-rate ~12% at peak, RTT normal. backend 'model-svc' returning 502/503. tailing logs now:
```
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=inference-gateway --since=2m | grep "503" | head
2026-04-02T14:01:12 gateway infer: upstream model-svc timeout id=abc123 503
2026-04-02T14:01:18 gateway infer: upstream model-svc connection reset 503
```

matt: Not Docker/container OOMs. Node CPU fine. I suspect a transient networking spike to the model-serving pool. Also seeing a bunch of duplicate PD alerts — incident-bot grouped them but PD is still paging people.

incident-bot: Auto-suppression applied: created temporary suppression rule `us-west-2-paging-suppress-1765432100` (10m) to reduce duplicate pages. Dedupe threshold=3/min, auto-group window=60s.

caroline: Good — please silence PD for the suppressed group while we triage. I'll also add a short note to the status page draft.

ops-bot: Executing PD silence: `curl -X POST https://api.pagerduty.com/maintenance_windows -d '{"service_ids": ["PDSVC-igw"], "duration_minutes": 10}'` -> maintenance id MW-9982 created.

alex: Quick mitigation — routing fallback to cached-model variant works. Pushing a canary route rule to send 10% traffic to cached-model. Command:
```
redwoodctl route update inference-gateway --fallback cached-model --weight 10
```

dan: Noted. Escalation triggered to SRE lead (me) because overall error budget hit 1.5% in last 10m. I'll take over once caroline does initial operation.

caroline: Handoff to @dan in 10m after I verify the fallback. Current customer impact: hosted API saw transient 5xx affecting ~2% of requests in us-west-2, errors largely on large-sequence requests (>2k tokens). Dedicated and Private customers appear unaffected per quick probe. One enterprise test-runner reported timeouts — we should follow up via support.

matt: Scaling suggestion: bump model-svc replicas +2 and extend backend timeout from 30s -> 60s for now to avoid cascades. I'm running: `kubectl scale deploy model-svc --replicas=6 -n inference`

incident-bot: PagerDuty note appended: "suppression applied; route fallback in progress; scaling in flight; monitoring". Auto-grouping metrics: merged 18 -> 2 distinct issue groups (upstream timeouts, model fallback errors).

alex: After fallback and scale we're seeing errors drop to ~0.8% in the last 3m. Keep an eye on rate of `KV cache miss` logs — if cache cold starts, we might see a secondary spike.

dan: Thanks — I'll keep monitoring and will post update in 15. If error stays <1% for 20m we'll close PD and remove suppression. If anyone sees re-paging, DM me. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident PD-7a1c23 status -> MONITORING. Suppression rule `us-west-2-paging-suppress-1765432100` scheduled to expire at 1765432700 (in 10m). Auto-unmute will occur unless extended.

caroline: Closing loop — i've added notes to the incident thread on PD, set a post-incident action to tighten dedupe thresholds and lower auto-group window (current 60s) because flapping caused extra noise. Will sync with SRE next oncall to adjust runbook.

matt: Logged follow-ups: A) investigate model-svc connection pooling B) add a soft-rate-limiter on large sequences C) improve PD mapping to reduce cross-service pages.

dan: Handoff complete. Monitoring until 14:50 UTC. If stable, we'll transition to postmortem. Thanks everyone.

incident-bot: Audit entry created: `suppression=us-west-2-paging-suppress-1765432100 created_by=incident-bot duration=10m dedupe=3/min`
